summary: IDS feed s081_single is degraded: 11.3% of frames (256/2266, up to 8058 bytes) exceed the IDS 1G port MTU of 1518 bytes and are dropped at the NIC before inspection. No other faults detected.

findings.root_cause: Feed carries jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes but the IDS ingress port and/or packet broker egress is still set to standard 1518-byte MTU without jumbo support. The NIC therefore drops any frame larger than 1518 bytes.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS never sees 11.3% of traffic - frames are discarded at the NIC before IDS processing. Because this IDS needs full payload for signature matching, this creates a large blind spot and missed detections, especially for large transfers.

params.target: IDS ingress port and packet broker egress toward IDS

recommended_fix.why: Tool needs full payload so slicing/trimming to 1518B would break detection. Enabling jumbo frames (MTU 9000+) end-to-end on the broker egress and IDS port allows large frames to be delivered intact without NIC drops.
